MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Breeze feels like a natural follow-up to Old Sock because I want more of Clapton’s relaxed blues sound.",
    "A Fool To Care connects with my interest in Memphis, while Otis Redding’s soulful singing also feels close to what I enjoy."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Wagner: Lohengrin does not connect with the blues and rock mood behind my recent choices.",
    "Vincebus Eruptum shares a rock connection with some of my listening, but its heavier psychedelic sound misses the relaxed feel I want today.",
    "I cannot connect The Essentials, Wrecking Ball, or x to my interests confidently from their titles alone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in guitar music seems to have been taken too broadly: enjoying Clapton and Hendrix does not mean I want every kind of guitar-driven rock right now.",
    "An album being broadly compatible with my listening does not make it something I will choose today; even Pink Floyd and Morning Phase were secondary interests on this visit."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The relaxed blues connection to Old Sock matters more to my immediate choice than a loose connection to rock.",
    "I rarely choose several albums at once. Passing over an appealing album today can mean I already found one strong match, rather than that I dislike it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my blues and soulful listening interests, but some missed the relaxed sound and strong personal connection I needed to choose one album today."
}
